answer: Each challenge commits to a domain-separated derivation of a future, unbiasable threshold-BLS beacon pulse, whose unpredictable and publicly verifiable output selects task parameters after submissions are bound. Therefore, a sybil swarm cannot precompute solutions, farm instances offline, or create identities only after seeing favorable parameters; commit-reveal timing preserves binding while concealing choices. Whether labeled jetty, terrace, or vault, every task remains beacon-entangled and equally costly.
